sourceRawArchive.description_zh: 类别：L 成分：拉塔基亚、弗吉尼亚、东方烟草 形制：粗碎烟丝（Rough Cut） Dunhill Durbar（杜尔巴）以「东方主调、沉郁华美」为核心定位，诞生于 1910 年，是登喜路历史最悠久的英式三方混调经典，代号 #1066。配方以高比例东方烟草作为主角，带来浓郁干燥花香与细致辛韵，为这支烟草赋予独特神秘气质；拉塔基亚提供稳定的木质烟熏底蕴，烟熏感克制不抢戏；熟化弗吉尼亚隐于底层，缓缓透出干草与淡雅蜜甜，平衡东方烟草的单宁质感。全程依靠烟叶原生发酵与长时间熟化堆积复合香气，无外加香精，烟气浓润厚实，抽吸凉爽顺畅，层次深邃含蓄，属于中等强度、饱满有重量感的英式老牌经典。 特别说明：Dunhill Durbar 烟丝裁切宽幅，色泽深褐均匀，质地紧实，装填前稍加松散处理更佳。点燃后燃速偏缓，钵内风味变化细腻，室韵沉雅，带有明显东方烟草的干花气息。适合深耕英式调配、喜爱东方烟草主导风格的资深斗客，适合静心长钵慢品。长期罐藏陈化可柔化东方烟草的辛涩感，让拉塔基亚木质烟熏韵更绵密，整体烟气圆润度大幅提升。本款已停产，后续替代版本为 Charatan Curzon Mixture，承袭原版配方思路，是登喜路英式阵容里东方烟草占比最高、风格独树一帜的传奇之作。
sourceRawArchive.description_en: Category: L Blend: Latakia, Virginia, Oriental Tobacco Cut: Rough Cut Dunhill Durbar, also known as code #1066, was first released in 1910. It is one of Dunhill’s oldest classic three-component English blends, themed as "Oriental-led, Deep and Elegant". This blend features a high proportion of Oriental tobacco as its core, delivering rich dry floral notes and delicate spice that lends a mysterious charm. Latakia forms a steady woody smoky base without overpowering the profile. Aged Virginia stays in the background, gently releasing hay and subtle honey sweetness to balance the tannic character of Oriental leaf. Crafted purely by natural tobacco fermentation and long-term aging, with no added flavourings. Smoke is rich, cool and smooth, with deep, restrained complexity. It is a medium-strength classic with substantial body. Special Notes: Dunhill Durbar has wide-cut tobacco of uniform dark brown colour and firm texture. Lightly rub out the tobacco before packing for best results. It burns slowly after ignition with subtle evolving flavours in the bowl. The room note is refined, marked by the dried floral aroma of Oriental tobacco. It is recommended for seasoned pipe smokers who are well-versed in English blends and favour Oriental-forward profiles, ideal for slow, contemplative long-bowl sessions. Extended jar aging softens the sharp tannic spice of Oriental leaf, rounds out Latakia’s woody smoke and enhances overall smoothness. This blend is discontinued. Charatan Curzon Mixture carries on the original recipe concept. It stands as a legendary Dunhill English blend distinguished by its dominant Oriental tobacco content.

sourceRawArchive.description_zh: 类别：L 成分：拉塔基亚、弗吉尼亚、东方烟草 形制：碎切片 Dunhill London Mixture 以「清熏淡雅、轻盈均衡」为核心定位，风格温和柔和，是适合日常品吸的英伦英式混调。配方中拉塔基亚占比拿捏得恰到好处，烟熏气息轻柔悠远，口感舒适不呛喉，也不会产生腻滞感。优质弗吉尼亚烟叶绽放清新草本香与天然蜜甜韵味，贯穿品吸全程协调整体风格，东方烟草添上细腻纯净的异域香底，让风味层次更富变化。烟气轻盈顺滑易入喉，入口质感干净平稳，香韵缓缓释放铺开，前段清隽雅致，中段醇厚圆润，尾段干爽利落收尾，抽吸节奏舒展惬意。 特别说明：Dunhill London Mixture 叶材配比轻盈柔和，门槛亲和，是接触英式混调的优质入门款式。干版烟丝质地干爽，防潮性佳，常温环境下便可稳定存放，点燃后燃烧流畅顺遂，几乎没有杂味干扰。整体风味协调百搭，烟熏香与清甜感配比适中，四季日常品抽都十分合宜。可作为纯弗吉尼亚与浓厚重口调性之间的过渡口粮，长期品尝也不易心生厌倦。凭借始终平稳温和的品质表现，稳坐登喜路系列畅销榜单，是口碑扎实的经典基础款斗草。
sourceRawArchive.description_en: Category: L Ingredients: Latakia, Virginia, Oriental Cut: Broken flake Dunhill London Mixture takes light smoky elegance and balanced mildness as its core feature, a mild British blend for daily smoking. The proper proportion of Latakia brings soft distant smoky aroma with comfortable non-irritating taste without cloying feeling. Premium Virginia tobacco releases fresh herbal and natural honey sweet flavor running through the whole smoking process. Oriental tobacco adds delicate pure exotic scent to enrich diverse taste layers. The light smooth smoke is easy to inhale with clean steady texture. The fragrance spreads slowly with elegant initial taste, mellow middle notes and dry neat finish, presenting a relaxed pleasant smoking rhythm. Special Description: With mild tobacco proportion, it is a friendly beginner choice for British blend lovers. The dry tobacco owns good moisture resistance and can be stored steadily at room temperature. It burns smoothly with barely any odd flavors. The well-balanced smoky and sweet taste fits daily smoking all year round. It can serve as transitional tobacco between pure Virginia and strong heavy blends without getting boring after long-time smoking. With consistent mild fine quality, it ranks among best-selling Dunhill products and becomes a reliable classic basic pipe tobacco.

sourceDescriptionEvidence.description_zh: 由弗吉尼亚草、卡文迪什、拉塔基亚和东方草组成的复杂调配。Aperitif意为开胃酒，名称暗示这款均衡、中等劲度的混合草适合餐前品味。

sourceRawArchive.description_zh: 类别：L 成分：拉塔基亚、弗吉尼亚、东方烟草、黑卡文迪什 形制：标准烟丝 Dunhill The Aperitif（开胃酒）以「餐前序曲、均衡立体」为核心定位，是 1951 年诞生的经典英式四叶混调，为登喜路手调系列代表作。风味架构以拉塔基亚的烟熏皮革韵打底，烟熏感较 965 收敛，沉稳而不失张力；无糖黑卡文迪什柔化烟气，带来绵顺厚实的本质，不带人工甜腻。熟成弗吉尼亚释放干草与浅浅草本蜜甜，东方烟草注入明亮辛香与干燥花果气息，层次随钵内抽吸不断演变，收尾辛感轻扬。全程依靠烟叶原生发酵熟化，无外加香精，烟气凉润顺滑，中段风味饱满立体，是一款中等强度、兼具深度与适口性的英式经典。 特别说明：Dunhill The Aperitif 烟丝色泽深浅交错，质地松软富弹性，裁切整齐，装填简易。点燃后燃烧平稳，钵内风味变化丰富，室韵柔和不刺鼻。命名原意即是餐前品吸，唤醒味觉，也可做全日草品饮。适合喜爱中等烟熏感、追求多层次变化的资深斗客，餐前小钵慢抽体感尤佳。长期罐藏陈化可让拉塔基亚的烟熏皮革感更为圆润，卡文迪什的质感更绵密，降低尖锐辛感。本款已停产，后续替代版本为 Charatan Four Leaf，承袭原版配方思路，是登喜路英式调配里独具序曲气质的经典。
sourceRawArchive.description_en: Category: L Blend: Latakia, Virginia, Oriental Tobacco, Black Cavendish Cut: Ribbon Cut Dunhill The Aperitif is a classic four-component English blend introduced in 1951 and a flagship of Dunhill’s hand-mixed line, themed as "A Prelude Before the Meal, Well-Balanced and Complex". The blend is built upon the smoky leather notes of Latakia. Its smoke profile is more restrained than 965, delivering steady character without losing intensity. Unsweetened Black Cavendish softens the smoke, offering a smooth, substantial core free of artificial sweetness. Aged Virginia brings hay and subtle herbal honey sweetness, while Oriental tobacco contributes bright spice and dry floral-fruity aromas. Flavors evolve continuously throughout the smoke, finishing with a gentle lift of spice. Made solely by natural fermentation and aging of tobacco leaves with no added flavorings. Smoke is cool, moist and smooth, with rich, well-defined mid-palate character. It is a medium-strength English classic with great depth and approachability. Special Notes: Dunhill The Aperitif features ribbon tobacco of mixed dark and light hues. The tobacco is soft and springy with clean cuts, easy to pack. It burns evenly once lit and offers a wide spectrum of in-bowl flavours, with mild, non-offensive room note. True to its name, it was crafted as an appetiser smoke to awaken the palate, and also works well as an all-day blend. It is ideal for seasoned pipe smokers who enjoy medium smokiness and evolving flavour profiles, best savoured in small bowls before meals. Extended jar aging rounds off Latakia’s smoky leather character, deepens the creamy texture of Cavendish and softens sharp spicy edges. This blend is discontinued. Charatan Four Leaf carries on the original recipe concept as its successor. It remains a distinctive classic among Dunhill English pipe tobaccos.

sourceRawArchive.description_zh: 类别：L 成分：弗吉尼亚、拉塔基亚、东方烟草 形制：标准烟丝 DUNHILL STANDARD MIXTURE 是登喜路（Dunhill）旗下经典的英式调配，被许多斗客视为英式混合的「基准线」。配方以弗吉尼亚烟草提供天然的甜润与麦香基底，东方烟草（土耳其叶）赋予其独特的香气与微微的辛感，拉塔基亚则带来标志性的烟熏与木质底蕴。开罐香气带有明显的烟熏感、淡淡的霉香与一丝甜意，烟丝呈现深浅交织的棕色，湿度适中。点火后，风味以东方烟草为主导，拉塔基亚的存在感较为内敛，整体呈现出柔和的烟熏、坚果与微微的甜味，口感顺滑且平衡。燃烧顺畅，烟气量适中，室韵可接受。 特别说明：STANDARD MIXTURE 的风味以「均衡」著称，L草含量偏低，香气与口感较为温和，适合全天品吸。它被形容为「西装革履、干净清爽」的风格，缺乏965或睡帽的浓烈个性，但正因如此，常被推荐给刚从调味草过渡到原味草的斗客作为入门之选。部分斗客认为其新草略显尖锐，陈化一段时间后风味会更为圆润融合。这款草非常适合喜欢柔和L草、追求平衡而非冲击感的斗客。
sourceRawArchive.description_en: Category: L Components: Virginia, Latakia, Oriental Cut: Ribbon Cut DUNHILL STANDARD MIXTURE is a classic English blend from Dunhill, widely regarded by pipe smokers as a "baseline" for English mixtures. The recipe features Virginia tobacco for natural sweetness and malty character, Oriental (Turkish) leaf for its distinctive aroma and subtle spice, and Latakia for signature smokiness and woody depth. The tin note offers evident smokiness, a musty quality, and a hint of sweetness. The tobacco presents as a ribbon cut with a mix of light and dark browns, at an ideal moisture level. Upon lighting, the flavor is led by Orientals, with Latakia playing a more restrained role. The overall profile is a soft smokiness with nutty and subtly sweet notes, smooth and balanced. It burns steadily with moderate smoke output and a tolerable room note. Special Notes: STANDARD MIXTURE is known for its "balance," with a lower Latakia content and a milder aroma and body, making it suitable for all-day smoking. It has been described as having a "buttoned-up, clean and crisp" character, lacking the intensity of 965 or Nightcap, yet this very quality makes it a frequently recommended entry point for smokers transitioning from aromatics to natural tobaccos. Some smokers find it a bit sharp when fresh, mellowing and integrating better with some cellaring. This blend is ideal for smokers who enjoy a gentle Latakia presence and seek balance rather than boldness.

sourceRawArchive.description_en: Category: V Blend: Virginia Cut: Flake Dunhill Light Flake is a classic pressed pure Virginia flake, themed "Pure Virginia, Light and Sweetly Gentle". It is composed solely of multi-grade pressed and aged Virginia tobacco. It delivers notes of hay, wheat aroma and subtle honey sweetness, accented by hints of citrus and dried fruit. The flavour profile is clean and transparent, free from heavy fermented richness. Made by natural tobacco fermentation and long pressed aging with no added flavourings. Smoke is light and delicate, cool and smooth, with consistent mild flavour. It is a light-bodied all-day pure Virginia flake classic. Special Notes: Dunhill Light Flake shows pale gold to amber-brown pressed flakes. The tobacco is compact yet easy to separate; you may pack as flakes or rub out according to preference. It burns evenly and holds light reliably, with fresh, mild and pleasant room note. It suits pipe smokers who enjoy clean, straightforward Virginia sweetness and a light smoking experience, ideal for morning sessions paired with coffee or tea. Extended jar aging amplifies dried fruit and honey sweetness, softens green herbal sharpness and rounds out the sweetness. Original Dunhill production has ceased. Peterson now continues production following the original recipe. It stands as the most elegant and mellow pure Virginia flake within Dunhill’s lineup.

descriptions.description_text:
弗吉尼亚草与佩里克组成传统VaPer调配，烟叶经卷制后切成带螺旋纹的圆片。这里收录的是Dunhill品牌包装的历史版本，来源商品标注约2013—2016年；该年份用于记录包装时期，不另拆成不同配方。

弗吉尼亚提供干草、烤麦和自然甜意，佩里克带来胡椒辛香、微酸及干果般层次。烟片以深棕为主，夹浅色纹理，质地较紧密。两种烟叶相互衬托，整体风格注重自然烟草味以及甜、辛之间的变化。

可将圆片折叠装填，也可轻揉后使用；装填过紧容易影响通气。烟叶湿度较高时可适度晾置，点燃后保持缓慢节奏，避免连续猛抽。折叠装填一般燃烧较慢，揉散则较易点燃。

这款为Dunhill品牌的历史版本，采用约50克罐装。Dunhill原品牌版本停产后，Peterson延续销售同名产品，两种品牌阶段在百科中分别保留；包装年代用于识别历史版本。

sourceRawArchive.description_zh: 类别：V 成分：弗吉尼亚、佩里克 形制：烟绳切片 (Rope Cut) Dunhill De Luxe Navy Rolls 以「绳压熟成、果甜辛雅」为核心定位，是登喜路殿堂级经典 VaPer，为海军绳卷形制的标杆代表作。风味架构以多产区精选弗吉尼亚为主体，经长时间绳状压制熟化，缓缓释放干草、烤麦与蜜饯般的天然甜韵，夹带无花果、葡萄干等深色干果香；适量佩里克注入独特胡椒辛感与微酸发酵果香，二者交融互衬，不会一方压过另一方。全程依靠烟叶原生发酵与长期绳压熟成，无外加香精，烟气清凉厚润，抽吸节奏缓慢，钵内甜感与辛香随品吸逐步演变，属中等强度、陈化潜力极高的传统 VP 经典。 特别说明：Dunhill De Luxe Navy Rolls 为手工绳卷后切片而成，呈螺旋纹圆饼状，色泽深褐夹杂琥珀纹路，质地紧实。可直接整片装填慢烧，亦可揉散后使用；建议适度醒草，更易点燃与控温。点燃后燃烧均匀持久，燃烧干净，室韵温柔醇厚，带有麦香与干果气息。适合执着纯叶本味、喜爱 VP 变化层次的资深斗客，闲暇静心长钵慢抽尤佳。长期罐藏陈化可柔化佩里克的尖锐辛感，让弗吉尼亚的干果蜜香变得更绵密圆润。本款登喜路原厂版本停产后，Peterson 沿用原版配方继续生产，Charatan Rolls 为同源替代款，是登喜路阵容里极具收藏价值的烟绳切片型 VP 传奇。
sourceRawArchive.description_en: Category: V Blend: Virginia, Perique Cut: Rope Cut Dunhill De Luxe Navy Rolls is a legendary premium VaPer blend themed "Rope-pressed Aging, Fruity Sweetness with Elegant Spice", the benchmark of traditional navy rope-cut pipe tobacco. Built with carefully selected multi-origin Virginia tobaccos matured under prolonged rope compression. It delivers notes of hay, toasted malt and candied natural sweetness, layered with dark dried fruit such as fig and raisin. A measured portion of Perique contributes distinctive peppery spice and tangy fermented fruit character, balancing perfectly without overpowering the Virginia. Crafted purely by natural tobacco fermentation and long rope pressing, no added flavourings. Smoke is cool and substantial with a slow burn. Sweetness and spice evolve gracefully across the bowl. It is a medium-strength VaPer classic with exceptional aging potential. Special Notes: Dunhill De Luxe Navy Rolls is hand spun into rope then sliced into spiral-patterned coin discs. Dark brown with amber marbling and firm texture. It may be packed whole for a slow cool smoke or rubbed out. Proper drying/conditioning is recommended for easier lighting and temperature control. It burns long and clean, with a gentle, rich room note carrying malt and dried fruit aroma. Ideal for seasoned pipe smokers who value leaf-forward flavour and evolving VaPer complexity, perfect for unhurried long bowl sessions. Extended jar aging softens Perique’s sharp pepper edge and deepens the creamy dried-fruit sweetness of Virginia. Original Dunhill production ceased. Peterson continues production preserving the original recipe, while Charatan Rolls serves as its successor. It is a collectible rope-cut VaPer icon from Dunhill’s catalogue.

sourceRawArchive.description_zh: 类别：L 成分：拉塔基亚、弗吉尼亚、东方烟草、佩里克 形制：碎切片 Dunhill Nightcap（睡帽）以「夜间浓韵、沉厚长燃」为核心定位，是登喜路传奇满体英式混调，为晚间品吸的经典代表。风味架构以浓郁饱满的拉塔基亚作为主轴，厚实的泥炭烟熏韵伴随木质与泥土气息，底蕴深邃有力；熟化弗吉尼亚缓缓释放干草蜜甜，平衡烟熏的厚重感；东方烟草带来干燥花果香与细致辛调，最后佩里克注入独特胡椒劲感与微酸果韵，拉高整体层次张力。全程依靠烟叶原生发酵熟化，无外加香精，烟气浓润绵密，抽吸需控温慢吸，风味在钵内持续演变，属于满强度、厚重有质感的英式经典。 特别说明：Dunhill Nightcap 烟丝深褐近黑，夹杂红棕叶丝，质地干松弹性佳，裁切整齐，装填简易。点燃后燃速缓慢持久，燃烧稳定，室韵浓厚带烟熏地气感。命名寓意为睡前的最后一钵，适合深耕英式调配、喜爱浓重拉塔基亚风格的资深斗客，晚餐后静心慢抽最为合适。长期罐藏陈化可柔化佩里克的锐利辛感，让拉塔基亚泥炭烟熏韵变得更绵密圆润，减少燥感。本款登喜路原厂版本停产后，Peterson 沿用原版配方继续生产，Charatan Eventide Mixture 为同源替代款，是登喜路英式阵容里满体 L 草的不朽传奇。
sourceRawArchive.description_en: Category: L Blend: Latakia, Virginia, Oriental Tobacco, Perique Cut: Broken flake Dunhill Nightcap is a legendary full-bodied English blend themed "Rich Evening Character, Slow Long Smoke", crafted as an iconic tobacco for night-time pipe sessions. Centered on rich, robust Latakia, it delivers deep peaty smoke with woody and earthy undertones. Aged Virginia offers gentle hay and honey sweetness to counterbalance the heavy smokiness. Oriental tobacco contributes dry floral-fruity notes and subtle spice, while Perique adds distinctive peppery bite and mild tangy fruit complexity to elevate the blend. Made solely by natural tobacco fermentation and aging with no added flavourings. Smoke is dense and creamy. Slow, cool puffing is required to unlock evolving flavours throughout the bowl. It is a full-strength, substantial English classic. Special Notes: Dunhill Nightcap features dark brown nearly black ribbon tobacco mixed with reddish-brown strands. It is dry, springy, neatly cut and easy to pack. It burns slowly and steadily after ignition, producing a deep, earthy smoky room note. As its name implies, it is meant for the final bowl of the day. It is recommended for seasoned pipe smokers familiar with English blends who enjoy prominent Latakia, best enjoyed after dinner. Extended jar aging softens Perique’s sharp pepper edge and rounds Latakia’s peaty smoke into a creamier profile, reducing harshness. Original Dunhill production has ceased. Peterson continues production preserving the original recipe, while Charatan Eventide Mixture serves as its direct successor. It stands as an immortal full-strength icon within Dunhill’s English lineup.

sourceRawArchive.description_zh: 类别：L 成分：拉塔基亚、东方烟草、卡文迪什 形制：标准烟丝 Dunhill My Mixture 965（965）以「简化英式、烟熏甜润」为核心定位，是登喜路经典英式三方混调，凭借简练叶材搭配塑造独特烟熏甜香风格。风味架构以拉塔基亚的泥炭烟熏与皮革韵作为主轴，烟熏质感醇厚柔和，没有粗粝燥感；东方烟草带来干燥花果香与细致辛调，增添层次灵动感；卡文迪什赋予绵顺润甜，融合三种烟草气质，让整体风味浑圆一体。全程依靠烟叶原生发酵熟化，无外加香精，烟气绵密饱满，抽吸凉润顺滑，钵内风味随抽吸缓缓演变，属中高强度、风格饱和的英式经典。 特别说明：Dunhill My Mixture 965 烟丝色泽深褐夹杂黑丝与红棕叶，质地松软有弹性，裁切整齐，装填简易。点燃后燃烧稳定，室韵带有大地烟熏混着卡文迪什的润甜香气。适合喜爱烟熏基底搭配天然甜润感的斗客，全日都可品吸。长期罐藏陈化可让拉塔基亚烟熏感变得绵柔，卡文迪什的甜润质感进一步提升，削减烟气潜在尖锐感。本款为简化配方版本，原版含有弗吉尼亚烟叶，是登喜路英式调配里面风味辨识度极高的经典。
sourceRawArchive.description_en: Category: L Blend: Latakia, Oriental Tobacco, Cavendish Cut: Ribbon Cut Dunhill My Mixture 965, simply known as 965, is a classic three-component English blend themed "Streamlined English, Smoky and Sweetly Smooth". It delivers a distinctive smoky-sweet character via concise tobacco selection. Built upon Latakia with peaty smoke and leather undertones, its smoky profile is rich and mellow without harshness. Oriental tobacco provides dry floral-fruity notes and subtle spice to bring lively complexity. Cavendish lends creamy natural sweetness and binds all three tobacco components into one rounded integrated profile. Made purely by natural tobacco fermentation and aging with no added flavourings. Smoke is dense, cool and smooth, flavours evolve gently through the bowl. It is a medium-to-full strength English classic with substantial character. Special Notes: Dunhill My Mixture 965 consists of dark brown ribbon tobacco mixed with black and reddish-brown strands. Soft, springy and neatly cut, easy to pack. It burns reliably after lighting. The room note combines earthy smoke and the creamy sweetness of Cavendish. It suits pipe smokers who appreciate smoky base paired with natural sweetness, great as an all-day smoke. Extended jar aging softens Latakia’s smoke and deepens the creamy sweetness of Cavendish, mitigating potential sharpness. This is the simplified formulation; the original recipe includes Virginia leaf. It remains one of the most recognizable Dunhill English blends.

sourceRawArchive.description_en: Category: L Blend: Latakia, Virginia, Oriental Tobacco Cut: Ribbon Cut Dunhill Early Morning Pipe (EMP, commonly known as The Rooster) is a classic mild three-component English blend themed "Morning Prelude, Gentle Smoky Elegance", crafted specifically for the first bowl of the day. Extended jar aging softens faint spice from Oriental leaf, rounds Virginia’s honey sweetness and mellows Latakia’s smoky character. Original Dunhill production has ceased. Peterson continues production preserving the original recipe, and Charatan First Bowl serves as its direct successor. It stands as Dunhill’s iconic morning-oriented English blend.

Royal Yacht（皇家游艇）以不同等级的弗吉尼亚草组成，并施以独特调味。本记录对应Dunhill品牌的历史包装，来源商品另带有锈迹、偏干等品相说明；这些属于该件库存的状态，不构成独立配方。

sourceRawArchive.description_zh: 类别：V 成分：弗吉尼亚、白肋 形制：标准烟丝 Dunhill Royal Yacht Mixture 以「草本温甜、坚果厚润」为核心定位，风格纯正典雅，属双叶种欧式原生混调。甄选多等级深度熟化弗吉尼亚烟叶，绽放饱满温暖的草本气息，伴随自然发酵沉淀的醇厚蜜香，入口质感柔润圆滑。搭配经典白肋烟叶，赋予烟体干爽坚果香、朴实谷物韵与沉稳木质底调，搭建起厚实立体的口感架构。风味甜感均源自烟叶自身熟化积淀，无人工添加调剂，烟气绵密纯净，抽吸斗温凉爽稳适，整体格调高贵素雅，越品越能体现内敛韵味。 特别说明：Dunhill Royal Yacht Mixture 沿用品牌经典双叶配比，干版形制经时熟化后，烟叶本味变得更加澄澈纯净。烟丝质地蓬松绵软，日常装填上手简单便捷，点燃后燃烧状态平稳持久，不易出现断火情况，长时品吸也不会产生干燥燥口的不适感。风味架构简约大气，香韵干净无多余赘余，室内散香低调舒服。契合摒弃人工调味、钟情温和原生本味的斗客喜好，无论闲暇独自慢品享受时光，还是多款烟草轮换抽吸都十分合适，是登喜路系列中质感温润百搭、久抽不腻的纯草经典之作。

descriptionRaw.en: Category: V Blend: Virginia, Perique Cut: Rope Cut Dunhill De Luxe Navy Rolls is a legendary premium VaPer blend themed "Rope-pressed Aging, Fruity Sweetness with Elegant Spice", the benchmark of traditional navy rope-cut pipe tobacco. Built with carefully selected multi-origin Virginia tobaccos matured under prolonged rope compression. It delivers notes of hay, toasted malt and candied natural sweetness, layered with dark dried fruit such as fig and raisin. A measured portion of Perique contributes distinctive peppery spice and tangy fermented fruit character, balancing perfectly without overpowering the Virginia. Crafted purely by natural tobacco fermentation and long rope pressing, no added flavourings. Smoke is cool and substantial with a slow burn. Sweetness and spice evolve gracefully across the bowl. It is a medium-strength VaPer classic with exceptional aging potential. Special Notes: Dunhill De Luxe Navy Rolls is hand spun into rope then sliced into spiral-patterned coin discs. Dark brown with amber marbling and firm texture. It may be packed whole for a slow cool smoke or rubbed out. Proper drying/conditioning is recommended for easier lighting and temperature control. It burns long and clean, with a gentle, rich room note carrying malt and dried fruit aroma. Ideal for seasoned pipe smokers who value leaf-forward flavour and evolving VaPer complexity, perfect for unhurried long bowl sessions. Extended jar aging softens Perique’s sharp pepper edge and deepens the creamy dried-fruit sweetness of Virginia. Original Dunhill production ceased. Peterson continues production preserving the original recipe, while Charatan Rolls serves as its successor. It is a collectible rope-cut VaPer icon from Dunhill’s catalogue.

Extended jar aging softens Perique’s sharp pepper edge and deepens the rich rounded dried-fruit sweetness. Original Dunhill production has ceased. Peterson now manufactures it preserving the original recipe. It stands as Dunhill’s iconic Latakia-free Virginia-Perique masterpiece.

descriptionRaw.zh: 类别：L 成分：拉塔基亚、东方烟草、卡文迪什 形制：标准烟丝 Dunhill My Mixture 965（965）以「简化英式、烟熏甜润」为核心定位，是登喜路经典英式三方混调，凭借简练叶材搭配塑造独特烟熏甜香风格。风味架构以拉塔基亚的泥炭烟熏与皮革韵作为主轴，烟熏质感醇厚柔和，没有粗粝燥感；东方烟草带来干燥花果香与细致辛调，增添层次灵动感；卡文迪什赋予绵顺润甜，融合三种烟草气质，让整体风味浑圆一体。全程依靠烟叶原生发酵熟化，无外加香精，烟气绵密饱满，抽吸凉润顺滑，钵内风味随抽吸缓缓演变，属中高强度、风格饱和的英式经典。 特别说明：Dunhill My Mixture 965 烟丝色泽深褐夹杂黑丝与红棕叶，质地松软有弹性，裁切整齐，装填简易。点燃后燃烧稳定，室韵带有大地烟熏混着卡文迪什的润甜香气。适合喜爱烟熏基底搭配天然甜润感的斗客，全日都可品吸。长期罐藏陈化可让拉塔基亚烟熏感变得绵柔，卡文迪什的甜润质感进一步提升，削减烟气潜在尖锐感。本款为简化配方版本，原版含有弗吉尼亚烟叶，是登喜路英式调配里面风味辨识度极高的经典。

Category: L
Blend: Latakia, Oriental Tobacco, Cavendish
Cut: Ribbon Cut


Dunhill My Mixture 965, simply known as 965, is a classic three-component English blend themed "Streamlined English, Smoky and Sweetly Smooth". It delivers a distinctive smoky-sweet character via concise tobacco selection. Built upon Latakia with peaty smoke and leather undertones, its smoky profile is rich and mellow without harshness. Oriental tobacco provides dry floral-fruity notes and subtle spice to bring lively complexity. Cavendish lends creamy natural sweetness and binds all three tobacco components into one rounded integrated profile. Made purely by natural tobacco fermentation and aging with no added flavourings. Smoke is dense, cool and smooth, flavours evolve gently through the bowl. It is a medium-to-full strength English classic with substantial character.


Special Notes: Dunhill My Mixture 965 consists of dark brown ribbon tobacco mixed with black and reddish-brown strands. Soft, springy and neatly cut, easy to pack. It burns reliably after lighting. The room note combines earthy smoke and the creamy sweetness of Cavendish. It suits pipe smokers who appreciate smoky base paired with natural sweetness, great as an all-day smoke. Extended jar aging softens Latakia’s smoke and deepens the creamy sweetness of Cavendish, mitigating potential sharpness. This is the simplified formulation; the original recipe includes Virginia leaf. It remains one of the most recognizable Dunhill English blends.

descriptionRaw.zh: 类别：L 成分：拉塔基亚、弗吉尼亚、东方烟草 形制：标准烟丝 Dunhill Early Morning Pipe（清晨斗，俗称公鸡）以「晨起序曲、轻烟雅韵」为核心定位，是登喜路经典轻型英式三方混调，专为一日第一钵品吸所设计。风味架构以明亮红色弗吉尼亚作为基底，释放干草、麦香与柔和天然蜜甜；搭配占比突出的东方烟草，带来干润花香与细致轻辛；仅少量加入拉塔基亚，只赋予含蓄的木质烟熏与淡淡皮革底蕴，不会抢走主调风采。全程依靠烟叶原生发酵与轻度压制熟化，无外加香精，烟气清凉干净，舌感刺激低，钵内风味温和连贯，属轻至中等强度、适合作为晨起开胃草的英式经典。 特别说明：Dunhill Early Morning Pipe 烟丝呈金棕、红褐与少量深黑丝交织，质地松软有弹性，裁切整齐，装填简单易上手。点燃后燃烧节奏平稳，不易熄火，室韵温婉怡人，烟熏感浅淡不冲。命名寓意一日的第一斗，唤醒味觉，适合喜爱低负担英式调配、偏好轻烟熏风格的斗客，晨间搭配咖啡品吸体感绝佳。长期罐藏陈化能够柔化东方烟草的细微辛感，让弗吉尼亚蜜甜更圆润，拉塔基亚烟熏韵更绵密。本款登喜路原厂版本停产后，Peterson 沿用原版配方继续生产，Charatan First Bowl 为同源替代款，是登喜路英式系列当中最适合晨抽的传奇佳作。
descriptionRaw.en: Category: L Blend: Latakia, Virginia, Oriental Tobacco Cut: Ribbon Cut Dunhill Early Morning Pipe (EMP, commonly known as The Rooster) is a classic mild three-component English blend themed "Morning Prelude, Gentle Smoky Elegance", crafted specifically for the first bowl of the day. Bright red Virginia forms the base, offering hay, wheat and soft natural honey sweetness. Prominent Oriental tobacco delivers dry floral notes and delicate light spice. Only a restrained touch of Latakia adds subtle woody smoke and faint leather undertones without dominating the profile.
